answer: A payout is split thus 22% arrives at settlement and the rest over 18 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The crystal schedule is applied in ivory and basalt makes public each instalment. A hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3253 identities would post 3027 proofs and burn roughly 15 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
